note: The 1952 Enchiridion and 1910 Raccolta independently confirm the traditional Roman/Clementine canticle. The 1902 Breviarium supplies a second liturgical-book witness and defines in full the Gloria Patri which its canticle page abbreviates. The Raccolta's equivalent fixed-formula cue is expanded openly. The 2005 Compendium is collated only for its fully written doxology because its preceding canticle is a distinct current biblical recension. Chant mediants and typography are recorded in witness headers but are not spoken tokens.

comparison_readings.ruling: The traditional Roman/Clementine readings are selected without conflation; the Compendium witnesses a distinct current recension.
The possessive belongs to the selected traditional recension and is independently confirmed.
